name: Moca (Puerto Rico, United States)
description: Divided horizontally blue over green with a magenta triangle at the hoist bearing a large yellow star surrounded by white stars, and a yellow triangle between them reaching towards the fly.
history: Moca is a town and municipality in northwestern Puerto Rico. The flag was designed by the Mocan painter Augusto Hernández Méndez at the request of the society commemorating the town's bicentennial; the magenta stands for the flower of the moca tree. The Municipal Assembly adopted it officially on 19 February 1972 and it was presented to the town on the bicentennial day, 22 June 1972.

features.role: magenta triangle at the hoist, the colour of the moca tree's flower
large star surrounded by small white stars
